_note: Landing sites. The mission name picks one (same name = same site). `patch` changes balance numbers for this mission only: `add` adds to a number, `set` replaces it; dotted paths reach inside objects (CELLS_BY_WEATHER.clear). Every site has a plus and a minus. Facts are on the site's album card (cards.json). Owner: P4 + P5.

sites.name: Gale Crater
sites.plus: Near the equator: 1 more cell on clear and hazy sols
sites.minus: No ice under the ground: start with less air & water

sites.name: Jezero Crater
sites.where: an old lake with a river delta
sites.plus: Rich old lake rocks: trips outside bring more samples
sites.minus: Farther from the equator: 1 cell less on hazy sols

sites.name: Utopia Planitia
sites.where: a plain halfway to the north pole
sites.plus: Ice under the ground: start with full air & water
sites.minus: Far from the equator: 1 cell less on clear sols

sites.name: Hellas Basin
sites.plus: Thick air overhead: less radiation every sol (game estimate)
sites.minus: Dust storms love Hellas: 1 cell less on dusty sols
